name: archify
description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
one_liner: A skill that turns a codebase or a rough description into polished, animated diagrams you can export as images — no drawing tool needed.
buyer: A freelance software consultant who needs professional-looking architecture diagrams for client proposals and handoffs.
business_use_cases: A consultancy adds a 'diagram deliverable' to every project handoff instead of paying a designer for slides.
A DevRel team auto-generates workflow diagrams for blog posts and conference talks.
A startup CTO produces onboarding diagrams for new engineers straight from the codebase.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'diagram pack' service: turn a client's messy architecture into a polished PDF/deck for a flat fee.
Offer a hosted team version with shared diagram libraries and version history.

steal_this: Package it as a $49 'instant system diagram' gig on Fiverr for indie devs who need investor-deck diagrams this weekend.
